text:
alex: Customer hit a 400 on /v1/invoke (toolcall) — says our SDK v2 sent payload that used to work.
api-gateway-bot: 400 ValidationError: additionalProperties "debug_flag" not allowed; required property "billing_profile_id" missing (schema: payments.invoke.funcSchema)
alex: req_id=rc_9f3b2a time=2026-02-12T18:04:23Z. Payload below — customer copied from our JS SDK (v2.1.0):
```json
{
  "tool": "payments:charge",
  "args": {
    "amount": 1200,
    "currency": "USD",
    "items": [{"id": "sku_12"}]
  },
  "meta": {
    "customer_id": "cus_abc",
    "debug_flag": true
  }
}
```
alex: our gateway returns the schema error above. Customer insists this worked last week.
maria: can you paste the exact server validation response body (headers and schema id)?
alex: full response: `{"error":"ValidationError","details":{"schema":"payments.invoke.funcSchema","errors":[{"path":"/","message":"required property 'billing_profile_id' missing"},{"path":"/meta","message":"additionalProperties 'debug_flag' not allowed"}]},"request_id":"rc_9f3b2a"}`
nate: quick read — two separate problems: 1) payments tool now requires billing_profile_id (new required) 2) validator has additionalProperties:false for /meta, so any top-level meta keys are rejected. Likely model/tool selection tried `payments:charge@v2` which tightened schema.
emma: hmm — customer passed billing info in args previously? alex: they used to put billing_profile in args.billingProfileId (camelCase) and our v2 schema enforces snake_case `billing_profile_id` — looks like a coercion/casing change.
maria: that would explain required field missing + type mismatch if coercion removed. Also the extra `debug_flag` is being rejected now because our function schema sets additionalProperties:false on meta.
api-gateway-bot: INFO: Selector chose runner payments-v2 (strict) for tenant tier "standard". Fallback not attempted because model declared incompatible.
nate: repro steps I ran: call /v1/invoke with the posted payload — same 400. Patch payload with "billing_profile_id":"bp_1" and move debug_flag into `args.debug` and it passes. Repro gist: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/invoke -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...' -d '{"tool":"payments:charge","args":{"amount":1200,"currency":"USD","items":[{"id":"sku_12"}],"debug":true},"billing_profile_id":"bp_1"}'`
emma: customer-facing workaround: advise them to include snake_case billing_profile_id at top level and avoid extra unexpected keys under meta. Long-term fix: support kebab/camel -> snake coercion and allow additionalProperties on meta or add compatibility shim.
maria: I think this is an on-by-default strict schema update during a recent runtime rollout. Eng-runtime should be notified — tagging @eng-runtime. Can someone capture timeline for when payments schema bumped?
alex: timeline: changeset 6f9a3 pushed 2026-02-11 02:12 UTC with note "tighten payments funcschema" — likely culprit.
nate: next steps: 1) escalate to eng-runtime with request to either re-enable legacy coercion for payments tool or add a compatibility shim, 2) send rollback or hotfix if customer on enterprise or dedicated, 3) update SDK release notes and docs about required snake_case billing_profile_id.
emma: I'll draft the customer reply: short repro, workaround, ETA for eng response, and offer to help apply temporary override for dedicated customers.
alex: thanks — filing a support escalation ticket now and attaching logs + this thread. :thumbsup:
